newsitem.title: USA: Olympic group to give back $300,000 to Atlanta.
newsitem.headline: Olympic group to give back $300,000 to Atlanta.

text.p: Corporation for Olympic Development will return more than $300,000 in unspent bond proceeds to Atlanta's bond program for infrastructure improvements, Atlanta Journal and Constitution said Wednesday.

The corporation had received $32 million of the proceeds from a $150 million city bond issue for parks, a pedestrian corridor and public art projects. Several projects it developed are still continuing, including the replacement of dead trees and repairs to cracked pavement.

The group plans to transfer the properties to the city, which will maintain them once the corporation offices shut down on Dec 20, corporation president Clara Axam said. The group is still drawing up a list of recommended projects that could be funded with the $300,000 it will return.
